node.statement: Kitaev diagonal repair: the direct-sum diagonal formula printed at approximate_algebras.tex:1254 and :2780-2783 is false (already for B=C direct-sum C), but every finite-dimensional C*-algebra B=direct-sum_{r=1}^m M_{d_r} has a finite phase-balanced diagonal D=sum_t q_t W_t^dagger tensor W_t with unitary W_t, q_t >= 0, sum_t q_t=1, ZD=DZ for every Z in B, pi(D)=I_B, and projective norm ||D||_pi=sum_t q_t||W_t^dagger||||W_t||=1, independently of block count and block dimensions.
